title: How to Refactor Python Code With an AI Agent
description: Learn how to refactor Python code with AI safely: find code smells, check that tests pin the behavior, and let an agent apply one refactoring at a time.
summary: Say you have a Python project that works, and nobody is filing bug reports for it. However, every change, fix, or new feature takes longer than it should and requires working on multiple files.
takeaways: The ai-refactor-python-starter.zip file holds the starter project, which includes the app’s code, a test suite, an agent skill, and the development tools you’ll use throughout this tutorial.

You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz How to Refactor Python Code With an AI Agent Check how well you can refactor Python code with an AI agent, from a verified plan and characterization tests to a quality gate on every change.
The .claude/skills/refactor-plan/ folder holds an agent skill that you’ll use to look for code smells with the help of your agent.
